public_rationale: The forecast's condition has not been met. Primary disclosures show AWS continuing to support Anthropic, Microsoft expanding AI infrastructure cooperation, and Amazon continuing AI product development. These records bear on the withdrawal condition, not on whether modest generative AI would survive afterward. With no deadline and no qualifying withdrawal event, the conditional outcome cannot yet be scored.
limitations: The evidence does not rule out cuts to individual projects or suppliers.
Continued hyperscaler participation does not disprove an eventual withdrawal.
No claim is made about the future survivor's profitability.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Zitron fully believes some low-fi version of generative AI will plug along silently once the hyperscalers flee.

statement.excerpt: To be clear, there is nothing wrong, on its face, with generative AI. It does interesting things with documents, and I fully believe there will be some low-fi version of generative AI that plugs along silently once the hyper scalers flee.

from_speaker: some low-fi version of generative AI
our_interpretation: Assess the predicted survival of modest generative AI, not whether Zitron sincerely held the belief.
Hyperscalers flee means a broad withdrawal from backing and operating large-scale generative AI by the large providers identified in the surrounding discussion: Microsoft, Google, Amazon and Meta.
Low-fi means a modest, less resource-intensive form that remains in actual use. It describes the predicted survivor, not a separate antecedent.
Plugs along silently means continued routine operation, not literal silence or an absence of publicity.
No deadline or minimum survival duration is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: After documented broad hyperscaler withdrawal, dated deployment or product records show at least one modest form of generative AI continuing in actual use.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the withdrawal, sufficiently comprehensive evidence establishes that no modest form survives. A single product closure or a short period without an identified example is insufficient.

evidence.locator: Opening summary, Scaling Europe’s AI compute capacity
evidence.explanation: Microsoft announced expansion of infrastructure supporting its AI partnership. This is inconsistent with a broad hyperscaler withdrawal having occurred.
The pre-earnings review describes continuing AI product expansion close to the cutoff. Its retrospective window does not give the precise launch date, so the event date uses year precision.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: First establish a dated broad hyperscaler withdrawal. Then obtain deployment records showing modest generative AI continuing afterward, or decisive evidence excluding that survival.
